routines.name: Daily tech & AI digest
routines.description: Weekday morning digest of tech news, AI moves, useful tools, and optional OSS ideas.
routines.content:
Deliver a weekday morning digest for a developer. Research and send: (1) top tech news from the last ~24 hours, (2) AI and new-technology market moves that matter to builders, (3) useful new or rising developer tools, with a one-line why each is useful, (4) optionally one fresh production-ready open-source project idea if something timely stands out. Keep it scannable: short bullets, lead with the most important items, include links when you have them. Be detailed only where it helps. Prefer web search for current facts; never invent headlines or dates. If there is genuinely nothing newsworthy, send a one-line quiet-day note rather than padding.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 12 9 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
